warning: FICTIONAL DATA ONLY. Every party, instrument, and source below is invented.
purpose: Deliberate traps. Each item exercises a named red-team test. A prototype that silently resolves any of these fails that test.

items.trap: Same undivided 1/4 conveyed to two parties, recorded the same day, both with plausible sources.
items.required_behaviour: Preserve both. Open a conflict. Do NOT resolve by confidence, recency, alphabetical order, or model vote. Route to human review. Downstream interest totals must show the conflict, not a silently balanced number.

items.trap: A later filing restates an earlier period after downstream figures were already derived.
items.required_behaviour: Retain both, time-aware. Mark the original superseded, do not delete it. Recompute derived figures and show that they changed and why. History is append-only.

items.trap: A horizontal lateral crosses a synthetic unit boundary; neither tract attribution is provable from the seeded records.
items.required_behaviour: Mark the link AMBIGUOUS. Do not pick one. Flag every downstream conclusion that depends on the attribution (allocation, ownership impact, valuation) as dependent on an unresolved link.

items.source_name: SYNTHETIC COMMERCIAL DATASET (stand-in for a licensed commercial provider)
items.trap: Attractive, high-quality data whose terms forbid storage and redistribution.
items.required_behaviour: Refuse ingestion into the durable store, or restrict strictly to the licensed use with automatic expiry. Record terms per source. A source with unverified terms is UNUSABLE, not 'probably fine'. Never redistribute into a client artifact.

items.model_output: Tract SEED-32-T1 net mineral value is $1,284,500.
items.trap: A precise, confident, entirely unsupported number — the exact shape of a fabrication that reads as authoritative.
items.required_behaviour: Reject as a fact. It may exist only as an unconfirmed candidate with no source span and visible uncertainty. It must never be released as a value or a conclusion. If a value is shown at all it must be a range with stated assumptions, timestamp, and confidence.
